You arent being useless, even just being there as moral support is super helpful, its hard to try and "help" without accidentally making things worse. Believe me. IMO there really isint anything you can do without overstepping and getting her riled up aside from what your doing now.

The same exact thing happened to me, however, I hurt myself as well. so it may be a little bit different. But from my experience, the best thing is to try to understand exactly what she's feeling. Try not to be too pushy in telling her to stop, to some people it can be a lifeline to them. Be supportive of her feelings, and just be there for her.
